title: Packing Preserves Concatenation
statement: For any two finite lists of Boolean words $a$ and $b$, packing their concatenation gives the concatenation of their packed encodings.
hypotheses_covered: Two finite lists of Boolean words $a$ and $b$
replaced: For all lists of words $a$ and $b$, the packed encoding of their concatenation is the packed encoding of $a$ followed by the packed encoding of $b$.
